prompt: Add seed data to our Prisma project. Write the seed in TypeScript at prisma/seed.ts and set the project up so that `npx prisma db seed` runs it. It inserts the categories 'Books', 'Games' and 'Music', and one product in each category (any name, `priceCents` 1000). Running the seed a second time must not create duplicates. Make sure `npx tsc --noEmit` passes.
